card.name: The letter V starting a word
card.fires_on: The letter v or V (or a short piece like 'viral') at the start of a word, usually right after a space, bracket or quote. It appears in words such as vaccinia, vena cava, vial, vulgar and Viverra.

modes.label: Lowercase v starting a word
modes.description: A bare v begins a word such as vaccinia, vial or vulgar.

modes.label: Capital V in names
modes.description: A capital V begins a place or species name.

modes.label: Space plus v before a Latin term
modes.description: A word beginning with v follows a space, as in vena cava or vitiensis.

card.writes: It promotes continuations that begin with V, such as vir and vid, so it helps spell out words starting with v.
card.plain: It lights up when a word is just starting with the letter V, and helps predict the rest of that word.
